existing_interactions.hypothesis: The opening-possession tie-break matters most when both starting units score at similar rates, and it fades when one unit's points per possession clearly exceeds the other's.
A starting-lineup change inside the race window moves the unit's scoring rate more than the season rating suggests, so lineup news interacts with unit efficiency.
The same offensive gap converts into a larger race advantage at N=50 than at N=10 because the signal accumulates linearly while noise grows with the square root of possessions.

unreg:race_to_n_points.existing_mechanism: Each team's points arrive in discrete possession-by-possession chunks produced by the starting units, so the race is a first-passage problem on two alternating scoring processes.
